name: rename_symbol
description: Atomic cross-file symbol rename via edit_transaction. Word-boundary-safe, string/comment-aware. dry_run=true (default) previews; set false to apply. Index optional (text fallback). After renaming, verify with test_bridge(action="run") and check mocks with mock_sync.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: Absolute path to the project root directory. Index optional (text fallback).

file.description: File where the symbol is defined (relative to workspace_dir)
